subject: angol
title: Eating habits
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le, mit és hogyan esznek az emberek, hasonlítsd össze a két étkezést, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire.

scenes.description: A mother, a father and their two children are having dinner together at the kitchen table. There is a big bowl of salad, some roast chicken and potatoes on the table. The phones are in a basket on the shelf, and the family are talking about their day. The younger child is telling a funny story and everyone is laughing.

A teenage boy is sitting alone at the desk in his bedroom late in the evening. He is eating a burger and chips from a paper bag and drinking cola while he is playing a computer game. There are empty crisp packets and cans on the desk. The only light in the room comes from the computer screen.

prompts: Describe the people and what they are eating.
What are the differences between the two meals?
Which picture is more typical of your family? Why?
followUpQuestions: How often does your family eat together?
What is a typical Hungarian dish that you like?
How often do you eat fast food?
Do you think it's important to eat together as a family? Why?
Can you cook? What can you make?

usefulPhrases.en: They are having a home-cooked meal.
In my family we usually eat together on ...

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In the first picture I can see a family of four having dinner at the kitchen table. They're eating roast chicken, potatoes and salad, which looks really healthy. Their phones are in a basket, so they're talking, and everyone is laughing. In the second picture a teenage boy is sitting alone in his dark bedroom. He's eating a burger and chips and drinking cola while he's playing a computer game. The main difference is that the first meal is healthy and sociable, while the second one is unhealthy and lonely. Both meals are at home, though. The first picture is more typical of my family, because my mum always says that dinner is for talking, not for phones. But I must admit that I sometimes eat crisps in front of my laptop too.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Can you cook? What can you make?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, a few simple things. My speciality is chicken paprikash, which my grandma taught me to make. I cooked it for my family last Sunday, and they loved it.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó mindkét jelenetet leírja, megnevezi a fő különbséget és egy hasonlóságot is, majd megindokolja, melyik kép jellemzőbb a családjára, és saját tapasztalattal zárja – minden irányító szempontra kitér.

Szókincs: az étkezés és a leírás szavai változatosak (roast chicken, sociable, lonely, crisps, speciality), az összehasonlításhoz pedig pontos kifejezéseket használ (The main difference is that …, while …).
Nyelvhelyesség: a képleírás következetesen folyamatos jelen időben szól (They're eating, he's playing), a saját szokásokat jelen egyszerű, a múlt vasárnapot egyszerű múlt fejezi ki.
Érdemes megtanulni: „The main difference is that …, while …”, „Both meals are at home, though.”, „is more typical of my family”, „But I must admit that …”.
